Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.scenemanager.utils.workspace

  • Related Packages

    org.jdesktop.lg3d.scenemanager.utils
     
  • Class
    Description
    WorkspaceKeys
    The workspace keystrokes of the native 3D desktop, resolved from raw modifier and key-code state so the mapping is pure and headless-testable.
    WorkspaceKeys.KeyCommand
    A resolved keystroke.
    WorkspaceKeys.Kind
    What a keystroke asks the workspace plugin to do.
    WorkspacePager3D
    The workspace pager as a scene-graph node: the pure-Swing WorkspacePagerPanel hosted on a SwingNode, so the painted strip becomes a texture on a quad that the WorkspacePlugin mounts on the front-most DesktopHudLayer.
    WorkspacePagerPanel
    The workspace pager's paint surface: a compact glassy strip of one cell per workspace, flanked by previous/next arrows, rendered offscreen into a SwingNode texture by WorkspacePager3D.
    WorkspacePlugin
    Multiple workspaces (virtual desktops) for the native 3D desktop: the plugin counterpart of the 2D/Swing desktop's WorkspaceModel + WorkspacePager pair, and the first window-management feature ported off the taskbar.
    WorkspaceRegistry
    The native 3D desktop's workspace bookkeeping: the pure mapping from a window id to "is this window shown right now", built on the desktop-agnostic WorkspaceModel the 2D/Swing desktop already uses.
    WorkspaceRegistry.Listener
    Notified after any change a pager should reflect: a workspace switch, or a window joining/leaving/moving.
    WorkspaceRegistry.VisibilitySink
    Shows or hides one registered window.
